revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing a broad factory corridor. Slightly distant oblique view at medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Scene includes safety rails, distant machinery, a clean matte concrete industrial floor, and partial shadow from nearby structure while keeping clear subject detail. Visible subject is a middle-aged woman with a sturdy build wearing dark work trousers and a muted green jacket with muted orange workwear accents, in a stable kneeling pose facing slightly away from the camera; neither chest nor pelvis spread horizontally on the floor. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture aesthetic, subject clearly visible, with a safety rail and a distant worker-shaped silhouette that is not the subject. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
